name: Marvel's Luke Cage
description: Given superstrength and durability by a sabotaged experiment, a wrongly accused man escapes prison to become a superhero for hire.

videos.title: Moment of Truth
videos.overview: With tension building in the streets of Harlem thanks to ruthless club owner Cottonmouth, Luke finds it increasingly difficult to live a quiet life.

videos.title: Code of the Streets
videos.overview: Luke is pulled deeper into the fight for his neighborhood when, as a favor to an old friend, he tries to help a kid who's in trouble with Cottonmouth.

videos.title: Who's Gonna Take the Weight?
videos.overview: In the aftermath of a chaotic event at a favorite Harlem hangout, Luke heeds the call to action -- and hits Cottonmouth where he'll feel it most.

videos.title: Step in the Arena
videos.overview: As he rescues a victim of Cottonmouth's vengeance, Luke remembers his earlier life and the conspiracy that led to his superhuman strength.

videos.title: Just to Get a Rep
videos.overview: Cottonmouth strikes back at Luke by taking his vengeance out on the people of Harlem, while detectives Knight and Scarfe face an unexpected threat.

videos.title: Suckas Need Bodyguards
videos.overview: After Cottonmouth and Scarfe's bloody clash, Luke realizes that saving the community may turn former allies into enemies, and enemies into allies.

videos.title: Manifest
videos.overview: Mariah's political career comes under fire, and Cottonmouth picks up information that could put Luke on the run.

videos.title: Blowin' Up the Spot
videos.overview: Mariah campaigns to turn the city and the police against Luke, and not even Misty or Claire may be able to save him.

videos.title: DWYCK
videos.overview: With Luke wounded and on the run, Misty faces a soul-searching interrogation. Mariah's rise to power takes a dark turn.

videos.title: Take It Personal
videos.overview: Luke gets closer to the truth about Reva and her part in his fate, while Mariah wrestles with the morality of her new role. Misty hunts for Luke.

videos.title: Now You're Mine
videos.overview: In one bold move, a friend from his past puts Luke on the defensive, Misty in dire straits, and Harlem's safety in jeopardy.

videos.title: Soliloquy of Chaos
videos.overview: Misty digs deeper for the truth as the neighborhood's power players throw the city into confusion.

videos.title: You Know My Steez
videos.overview: With all of Harlem bearing witness, Luke takes on the fight of his life in hopes of emerging as the defender his city needs.

videos.title: Soul Brother #1
videos.overview: As Luke adjusts to his growing fame and tries to shut down the flow of heroin branded with his name, someone from his past reaches out.

videos.title: Straighten It Out
videos.overview: Luke tests out his abilities on the ballfield, Misty ruffles feathers at the precinct, and Mariah plans a reunion to boost her image.

videos.title: Wig Out
videos.overview: Worried Luke is headed down a dark path, Claire pays a visit to his father. Bushmaster makes a bid for Mariah's guns.

videos.title: I Get Physical
videos.overview: As footage of his fight with Bushmaster goes viral, Luke struggles with the aftereffects and follows a trail of clues to Tilda's shop.

videos.title: All Souled Out
videos.overview: Desperate to drum up quick cash for a lawsuit, Luke weighs an offer from a superfan. Mariah invites Tilda to join the new family business.

videos.title: The Basement
videos.overview: As a wave of violence rocks Harlem, everyone races to connect the dots between Piranha, Mariah, Bushmaster and the grisly find at the clinic.

videos.title: On and On
videos.overview: Reeling from the showdown on the bridge, Luke teams up with Misty to find Piranha. The hunt for the snitch heats up. Bushmaster reveals his endgame.

videos.title: If It Ain't Rough, It Ain't Right
videos.overview: While Shades, Mariah and Misty come to terms with the previous night's events, Bushmaster searches for a way to boost his strength.

videos.title: For Pete's Sake
videos.overview: Hunkered down in a makeshift safe house, Luke and Misty butt heads over how to handle Mariah. Meanwhile, long-buried family secrets come to light.

videos.title: The Main Ingredient
videos.overview: Danny Rand insists on helping Luke hunt for Bushmaster -- the Iron Fist way. Mariah sets out to reclaim her empire. Misty pursues a traitor.

videos.title: The Creator
videos.overview: Shaken by Mariah's latest act, Luke combs the city for a witness. Flashbacks reveal a fateful encounter between the Stokes and McIver families.

videos.title: Can't Front on Me
videos.overview: Luke teams up with an unlikely ally to combat a new strain of heroin. As Shades plows ahead with his plan, a massive party draws everyone to the club.

videos.title: They Reminisce Over You
videos.overview: Mariah adapts to her new circumstances and goes to extremes to cover her tracks. Luke takes a new approach to protecting Harlem.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 6 wins & 23 nominations total
